title: Row Row Row Your Boat: Why Giant Heavy Boats Float on Water!

lines.text: Row row row your boat gently down the stream, merrily merrily merrily life is but a dream!
lines.caps: Row row row your *BOAT | gently down the *STREAM, | merrily merrily *MERRILY | life is but a *DREAM!

lines.text: Why does a tiny pebble sink like a rock, but a giant heavy boat floats on water?
lines.caps: Why does a *TINY | pebble sink like a *ROCK, | but a giant heavy boat *FLOATS | on *WATER?

lines.text: Pebbles are solid and heavy for their size, so water cannot hold them up!
lines.caps: Pebbles are *SOLID | and heavy for their *SIZE, | so water *CANNOT | hold them *UP!

lines.text: Boats are hollow and wide, pushing aside gallons of water!
lines.caps: Boats are *HOLLOW | and *WIDE, pushing | aside gallons of *WATER!

lines.text: That pushed water pushes back upward with a secret lifting force called Buoyancy!
lines.caps: That pushed water *PUSHES | back upward with a *SECRET | lifting force called *BUOYANCY!

lines.text: As long as the boat is wide and hollow, buoyancy keeps it floating high!
lines.caps: As long as the boat is *WIDE | and *HOLLOW, | buoyancy keeps it *FLOATING | *HIGH!

lines.text: Grab your oars and paddle along the stream of science!
lines.caps: Grab your *OARS | and paddle *ALONG | the stream of *SCIENCE!

lines.text: Now you know the floating secret behind Row Row Row Your Boat!
lines.caps: Now you *KNOW | the floating *SECRET | behind Row *ROW | Row Your *BOAT!

lines.text: Glide along with us and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
